What IHD wires

Five jobs, from their own services list.

  • Full and part rewiring

    A whole house or a single room. Two of the reviews below are whole-house jobs.

  • Consumer units

    The fuse board, replaced and wired.

  • Additional wiring

    Extra sockets, switches and lighting, indoors and out.

  • CCTV installation

    Their homepage says CCTV is what IHD specialises in. Their gallery has no CCTV photos, so ask what they have fitted.

  • Emergency callouts

    Listed on their site. No hours are published, so ask when you ring.

Also in their gallery: EV chargers, feature lighting, smart heating controls and outdoor junction boxes.
